_comment: Octail's own egg (pelican-eggs' games-steamcmd arma3 egg was read as a reference only). App 233780 (Arma 3 Server) is not available to anonymous SteamCMD logins, so the egg uses Octail's steam_login feature (required): the Steam account picked on the Startup tab logs in, Steam Guard codes are asked for in the console and the login is cached for start-time updates. Bohemia says the account doesn't need to own Arma 3 for the server itself; Steam Workshop downloads (app 107410, the steam.workshop tool) do. The Linux depot is downloaded, SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times and the install fails when arma3server_x64 is missing. basic.cfg and server.cfg are written by the install when missing; server.cfg's name, passwords, slots, BattlEye, signature check and persistence lines are set by the file parser before every start. Mods: Workshop items (workshop/<id>), uploaded folders and server-side mods go to -mod/-serverMod, their .bikey files to keys/, optionally lowercased. The Steam query (+1), Steam (+2) and BattlEye (+4) ports are reserved with fixed_ports; BattlEye RCon (optional, its own port) is written to battleye/beserver_x64.cfg. The server reads no console input and stops on Ctrl+C. SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Arma 3
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Bohemia Interactive's Arma 3: the official Linux dedicated server (arma3server_x64) from SteamCMD, with Workshop and uploaded mods. Needs a logged-in Steam account (anonymous SteamCMD can't download it).
startup:
octail_mods=""; for octail_id in ${WORKSHOP_MODS//,/ }; do octail_mods="${octail_mods}workshop/${octail_id};"; done; octail_mods="${octail_mods}${MODS}"; octail_mods="${octail_mods%;}"; mkdir -p keys; IFS=";" read -ra octail_dirs <<< "${octail_mods};${SERVER_MODS}"; for octail_d in "${octail_dirs[@]}"; do [ -n "${octail_d}" ] || continue; if [ ! -d "${octail_d}" ]; then echo "Mod folder ${octail_d} is missing; the server starts without it."; continue; fi; if [ "${MODS_LOWERCASE}" = 1 ]; then find "${octail_d}" -mindepth 1 -depth -name "*[A-Z]*" -exec sh -c 'for p; do n="${p%/*}/$(printf %s "${p##*/}" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"; [ -e "$n" ] || mv "$p" "$n"; done' sh {} +; fi; find "${octail_d}" -iname "*.bikey" -exec cp -f -t keys {} +; done; if [ -d battleye ]; then for octail_be in battleye/beserver_x64.cfg battleye/launch/beserver_x64.cfg; do [ -d "${octail_be%/*}" ] || continue; touch "${octail_be}"; sed -i -e "/^RConPassword /d" -e "/^RConPort /d" -e "/^RConIP /d" "${octail_be}"; [ -z "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ] || printf "RConPassword %s
RConPort %s
RConIP 0.0.0.0
" "${RCON_PASSWORD}" "${RCON_PORT}" >> "${octail_be}"; done; fi; exec ./arma3server_x64 -ip=0.0.0.0 -port="${SERVER_PORT}" -name=server -profiles=profiles -cfg=basic.cfg -config=server.cfg -bepath=battleye "-mod=${octail_mods}" "-serverMod=${SERVER_MODS}" -loadMissionToMemory

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD (the saved login of the server's Steam account) before every start.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no " or \).

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Players need it to join; empty for an open server. Letters, digits and _.@%+!- only.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Typed in the game's chat as #login <password> to become admin (#missions, #kick, #restart). 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-.

variables.name: Signature check
variables.description: 2 kicks players whose mod files aren't signed by a key in keys/; 0 turns the check off.

variables.name: Persistent
variables.description: 1 keeps the mission running when the last player leaves, 0 restarts it.

variables.name: Workshop mods
variables.description: Steam Workshop item ids, comma-separated, in load order. The Steam Workshop tool fills this in and downloads them to workshop/<id> (needs a Steam account that owns the game); they load before the mods below.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Uploaded mod folders in the server folder, separated by ; in load order (for example @cba_a3;@ace). Players need the same mods.

variables.name: Server-side mods
variables.description: Mod folders only the server loads (-serverMod), separated by ;. Players don't need them.

variables.name: Lowercase mod files
variables.description: 1 renames every file and folder inside the listed mod folders to lowercase before each start. Linux is case-sensitive: turn it on when the server can't find files of a mod made on Windows.

variables.name: BattlEye RCon password
variables.description: Turns on BattlEye RCon for RCon tools (BEC, BattleWarden, …) when set: 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-. Empty leaves RCon off. Octail's console doesn't use it.

variables.name: BattlEye RCon port
variables.description: The BattlEye RCon port (UDP). Set by Octail when the server is created (five after the game port).
